profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft | Microsoft Frontier Company
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer at Microsoft in the NYC area, having graduated from RIT with a degree in Software Engineering. 

I'm energized by new software challenges and I'm devoted to developing dynamic and efficient solutions with maintainable and extensible code. A major focus of mine is continuous learning. I regularly work on new team projects, participate in hackathons, experiment with new frameworks and AI techniques, and work to improve my skillset.

My current technical focuses include AI agent development, infrastructure, and distributed systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Led the backend development and design of Daily Merchant Payouts, enabling thousands of merchants to receive earnings 5 times faster during the COVID-19 pandemic
- Designed and shipped numerous features (Go, Python Django) for critical payment processing flows for all customers, eliciting requirements from product owners and writing RFCs for iterative feedback
- Led production deployments across several critical services with CI/CD (Jenkins and DroneCI)
- Communicated with an agile team of experienced engineers in person as well as remotely across time zones, also driving communication with support from external integrations (e.g. Stripe)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed, implemented, and deployed several Azure Functions (NodeJS and .NET) to demonstrate standard scenarios for authentication/authorization with Azure Active Directory
- Unblocked numerous corporate customers by establishing and demonstrating best practices for securing Azure Functions following OpenID Connect standards
- Engaged directly with a corporate customer working with Azure Functions and the Serverless framework
- Collaborated with experienced engineers to uphold software engineering principles and agile processes

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented numerous features on a large enterprise web application used by financial advisors (Angular with TypeScript and Java with Spring)
- Integrated code changes between different layers of the stack (front-end, services, back-end)
- Collaborated as part of a talented global team, managing time zone differences and efficient communication with teammates while following agile processes (code reviews, sprints, stand-ups)

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description:
- Improved the reusability and maintainability of Order Entry Systems by facilitating the migration for order validation from mainframe to distributed systems
- Launched and integrated modular and reusable data services to achieve this goal using popular technologies and frameworks (Java 8, Spring, Apache Camel, Apache Velocity)
- Developed generic Angular HTTP service to flag when all asynchronous requests in a web page have been completed for a reusable PDF generation utility (ES6 JavaScript and AngularJS)
- Worked closely with Senior Engineers, Mainframe Developers, and Business Analysts for input

positions.title: Tech Intern
positions.description:
- Instructed and mentored team of high school students in completing General Assembly's User Experience Design course
- Worked in a small team of other tech interns to develop a web app to promote the message of diversity in the professional field of technology
- Built the back-end of the web app using Node.js, Express.js, and Handlebars and hosted it on Heroku
- Served as lead programmer for the game on the web app, using pure JavaScript and HTML5 canvas to develop the game mechanics and physics engine

positions.title: Tech Ops - Cyber Security Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with Senior Security and Site Reliability Engineers monitoring alerts and logs utilizing tools such as Splunk and Sguil
- Developed a python-based web app to scan the internal network to increase visibility into all internal and public-facing hosts
- Configured and created Postgres databases and integrated them remotely using python
- Set up servers through AWS
- Wrote custom Nmap scripts and bash scripts to efficiently execute the scans on each host with the proper parameters

projects.title: Technically Late
projects.description:
Technically Late
- A game that promotes diversity in the technology field
- 2-Dimensional platforming game that requires the user to retrieve a gem within the allotted time depending on the selected difficulty

projects.title: City Tower Defense
projects.description: For a group project for the NYC Games for Change Student Challenge competition, we decided to create a tower-defense-like game. The focus of the game is to set up towers to shoot water at the dirty and polluted cars in order to clean them before they pollute the city, promoting the fight against pollution.

organizations.name: New York On Tech
organizations.description: New York On Tech is a technology-focused program that pairs you with a mentor from somewhere in the professional tech field. Every Saturday, a 4-hour workshop is held and one Saturday a month, a mandatory mentor meet-up workshop is held. NYOT teaches high school students from all different backgrounds with different aspirations that technology is at the root of every industry and that everyone should have some exposure to it. It does this by teaching students how to code through web development. Also, there is an emphasis on building a strong network between other members of the program to make the members more well rounded and out of their comfort zone.

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Alpha Mentoring Program
organizations.description: The Alpha Phi Alpha Mentoring program provides young black and latino men with mentors from various professional fields to guide them in their academic and professional careers and teach them life skills. One Saturday a month, the group meets as a whole and has a workshop to discuss a new topic, be it anywhere from fatherhood to crafting a resumé.
